title: The Missing Courier
description: My courier should have reached Thornfield four days ago and I've heard nothing - not from him, not from the man he was carrying papers to. He's missed deadlines before when the ale was good, but never this long. Ask at the inn before I have to write off both the courier and the contract.

objectives.description: Ask the innkeeper what he heard about the courier

notes: Threat: a missed delivery threatens a merchant's contract with a Thornfield trader. Giver motive: he needs answers before he writes off both the man and the deal, and the town guard won't chase a late courier. Consequence of refusal: unwired - the contract lapses.
